evidence_support_direction: Decree 662/2024 mandates discretionary caps and selection rather than automatic formulaic entitlement.
PAS Incentive requires contacting the team and board approval based on dates; not a statutory right.
Assigned Production Investment is selectively assessed based on creative readiness and market attachments.
CORFO IFI Audiovisual is a selective competitive grant with fixed funding caps and specific committee approvals, not an automatic entitlement.
Screen Scotland's fund is selectively assessed and capped, not an automatic statutory credit.
